missionEventData.data2: Fresh from their stunning success against the Invincible, the Alliance has found renewed hope in their struggle against the Empire. Joined by new allies from Sullust and Mon Calamari, Ace pilot Keyan Farlander and the Rebel Alliance must now continue the fight. But rumour has it that the Empire has a secret project of such awesome destructive power that it could destroy not only the Alliance but resistance itself.

missionEventData.data1: Warning! Gravitic anomaly detected. This is not a drill! Repeat, gravitic anomaly detected. This is not a drill. All star fighter pilots to your ships. Red Squadron, you will be joined by two of our Tie Fighter pilots. They will be under your command.

Thanks Red Squadron, that’s two we owe you. We have no idea who those Pirates were or how they were generating that gravitic anomaly, but hopefully that’s the last we see of them. But don’t get complacent. We have urgent news for the fleet…
What have we picked up in our little hyperspace trap today. An Imperial ship? With incom fighters? How interesting.
Red Squadron. We're picking up some very strange readings. Some kind of artificial gravity mass. Looks like it pullled us out of Hyperspace. Keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
This is the Rand Ecliptic to unknown craft. State your intentions.
Hmmm, that is a funny way for one of the Emperor's minions to speak. Not arrogant enough. You are not Imperials I think...
I repeat. Unknown vessel state your intentions or risk being fired upon.
I have a different suggestion, Not-Imperials. Surrender your vessel and we will spare your lives.
Well, that's enough of an intention. All hands beat to quarters. Red Squadron, defend the Rand Ecliptic from star fighter attack while we try to compensate for these gravitic anomalies.
You were a bad catch Rebel scum. We will be sure to remember to repay you in kind for our losses.
And Hobbie Klivian will be happy to kick your ass all over again.
Don't tell him your name idiot.
I will certainly make a point of remembering you... Hobbie Klivian.
Well done Red Squadron. We've successfully compensated for the artificial anomalies. And we'll be underway again shortly.
Feisty little creatures... you be Rebels me think... don't make me destroy you...

missionEventData.data2: You have no idea who you're dealing with

missionEventData.data1: You have no idea who you're dealing with
We're just getting started my friend.
I assure you. You are not my friend. And people who are not my friend, tend to end up dead.
You have no idea who you're dealing with friend.
On the contrary. I know exactly who I'm dealing with. A bunch of jumped up farm hands trying to play galactic politics...
Back out now while you still can.
Yes, I could back out if I wanted to. But you, my trapped friend, cannot.
I... I am original. You are no different from every other two-bit reactionary.
Red Lead. It's an honour to fly with you sir... to fly for the right side.
Happy to have you Alpha Two.
Only three left. We're going to clean you up.
TGS - M06 Search for Imperial Convoy
That's not an asteroid... what the hell is that thing. It's giving off some crazy readings...
